message.content: The “best” movie of 2020 can vary depending on who you ask—critics, audiences, or specific genres—but one film that consistently topped lists and received widespread acclaim is **“Parasite”** (though it was released in 2019, it had a significant impact in 2020). If you’re looking for a 2020 release that stood out, many critics highlighted **“Tenet”** (though it had mixed reviews) and **“The Trial of the Chicago 7”** for its powerful storytelling. For a more universally praised 2020 original, **“The Irishman”** (though released in 2019) and **“The Two Popes”** were notable. If you want a definitive answer, you might consider looking at the top-rated films on Rotten Tomatoes or IMDb for 2020, which often list **“Parasite”** as the highest-rated film of that year.
